capacity_helper.execution_note: actual execution used the byte-identical private tmp path; public file is not relabeled as the historical execution path

limitations: Each child trains only two fixed unique actual batches and evaluates the complete1576-hand validation once; no full training or best/early-stop selection.
Every child freshly verifies original numeric checkpoints and rehashes/scans the entire frozen cohort before CUDA entry; no cross-process stat-only shortcut.
Memory peaks are actual reserved/allocated observations. Validation reserved memory includes retained training cache; the cache was not cleared to manufacture a margin.
This is single-card/workers0 engineering. It does not establish original6-rank BatchNorm/global-batch equivalence, long-run leak stability, next-step deterministic agreement or scientific scores.
Final formal source still requires independent acceptance before production; capacity success alone does not authorize a new runner.
Public aggregates omit private paths, participant/sample identifiers, process IDs and GPU UUID.

policy.scaler: default actual Lightning GradScaler, no tuning or injected faults

scope: bounded actual CUDA train/validation capacity engineering evidence; no scientific training result
